record.title: AN0846 Analytic 0846
record.content: 名称=Analytic 0846；说明=Adversary enumeration of local user accounts using Net.exe, WMI, or PowerShell.；适用平台=[Windows]；参考日志=[名称=WinEventLog:Sysmon；日志通道=EventCode=1]；核查要点=[核查字段=CommandLinePattern；说明=Detects variations of 'net user', 'net localgroup', 'Get-LocalUser'. | 核查字段=UserContext；说明=Restrict monitoring to low-privileged or unexpected users executing enumeration. | 核查字段=TimeWindow；说明=Tune for bursts of enumeration commands in short succession.]
